import itertools

        integer_E_values[E_int].append((a, b, c))

print("--- Found Solutions ---")
for sol in integer_solutions:
    print(sol)

print("\n--- Unique Integer Values of E ---")
print(list(integer_E_values.keys()))

print("\n--- Summary ---")
print(f"Total integer solutions found: {len(integer_solutions)}")
